basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 DEO, Project Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Microbiology at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry has six contract posts in the project "Establishment of Regional Level Viral Research and Diagnostic Laboratory", funded by DHR, for a likely duration of one year. The posts are Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) (1), Project Technician III (2), Research Assistant (1), Project Nurse (1) and Data Entry Operator (1), with pay from ₹20,000 to ₹56,000 a month (20% HRA on top for two posts). Applications are made only online through each post's own form link, on or

No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification and the maximum age limit of each post are given below. The age is counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. For Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical), Project Technician III, Research Assistant and Project Nurse, the notice gives "Age relaxation to various category in accordance to GOI instructions". The Data Entry Operator section does not mention age relaxation. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization, and experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Ph.D. degree in Microbiology/ Biotechnology/Veterinary Sciences subject from a recognized University with first class relevant degree. Additional Post-doctoral research / training experience in relevant subjects in recognized institute(s). Two years R&D / Teaching experience in relevant subject after obtaining essential qualification. Experience in handling clinical samples, serological and molecular techniques, cell culture methods, NABL accreditation-ISO 15189. Knowledge of Computer Applications or Business Intelligence tools/ Data Management. A Ph.D degree in the relevant subject shall be treated as equivalent to three years' experience. One year work experience in molecular techniques especially Real time PCR, and ELISA. Experience in BSL-2 laboratory or higher. Two years' work experience in molecular techniques especially Real time PCR, and ELISA. Experience in BSL-2 laboratory or higher. One work experience in patient recruitment, sample collection – oropharyngeal/nasal swab, blood. Knowledge of Computer Applications with good typing skill for data entry work. Minimum 1 year data entry experience in a medical diagnostic laboratory. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: 1st class Master's degree in life sciences from a recognized university Or 2nd class M. Sc. + Ph.D degree in life sciences from a recognized university
B. Sc. / Intermediate with diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or High School with 5 years Lab experience.

Degree in Nursing or equivalent from a recognized University/Institution. Or Diploma in Public Health Nursing from a recognized Institute with Two years' experience as Staff Nurse in a recognized Hospital/Institution.
Graduate from a recognized University with knowledge of data entry work.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After evaluation of the application form, the recruitment process has two stages: a written test of 80 marks and an interview of 20 marks. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview, and the decision of the Project Investigator will be final. On negative marking, the notice states: "No negative mark shall not be detected for wrong answer." Eligible candidates will receive an email notification regarding the online screening test. The list of shortlisted candidates for interview will be posted on the JIPMER website. The date and time of the interview will be notified one week in advance. For a videoconference interview, the candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer/laptop/mobile) with audio and camera and an adequate internet connection. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Recruitment 2026 under this advertisement?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) 1, Project Technician III 2, Research Assistant 1, Project Nurse 1 and Data Entry Operator 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 07/12/2026 (Monday) before 04.30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for JIPMER Project Technician III?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B. Sc. / Intermediate with diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or High School with 5 years Lab experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical), Project Technician III, Research Assistant and Project Nurse, and 28 years for Data Entry Operator, as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) gets ₹56,000.00 and Project Technician III ₹28,000.00, each plus HRA 20% per month; Research Assistant and Project Nurse get ₹35,000.00 consolidated, and Data Entry Operator ₹20,000.00 per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any other allowance paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA 20% is paid only to Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) and Project Technician III; for all posts, no other allowances are payable beyond the consolidated salary.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Google Form link given for your post, uploading self-attested documents in PDF format (1 MB or less); offline or hardcopy applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates take a written test of 80 marks and an interview of 20 marks; the interview may be in person or via videoconferencing.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JIPMER project job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely on contract basis for an externally sponsored project, time bound for 1 year, with no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
